verdict.rationale: The docs say Jules generates a plan after a task is submitted, and the user can review and approve it before any code changes are made (jules-docs-4). The API also exposes explicit plan approval for sessions that require it (jules-docs-17), and the PR and diff approval steps add later gates on repository changes (jules-docs-7, jules-docs-8). missing for 10: a formal scope/contract artifact beyond a plan, approval by a designated reviewer (e.g. an engineering lead) separate from the task submitter, documentation of how required plan approval is configured or enforced, and independent hands-on corroboration of the plan-approval gate.
